chapter: Looking back and the lean years
title: The Hang-Over Club in San Francisco and the cost of two cars
summary: He takes bands including Barufaldi and Ricky Nelson to California, where extensions never become a steady job and travel costs mount.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California

blocks.x: And, so, all those guys were doing the same and that's exactly what they're doing now and in the beginning - I went to California on a couple of occasions and I took you know, like Joe Barufaldi, Ricky Nelson - a guy named Pruitt on bass and it was a great band and we worked at a place called the Hang-Over--

Sometimes I'd go out there - say he'd give me-- start me off with four weeks and I'd stay eight. So, I figured the only thing I could do in this case would -- I bought a stationwagon which was a damn expensive thing for me to do at that time - I bought a big stationwagon and I had a Lincoln that I was driving so it took two cars to transport that band and you think about the cost

of traveling all the way from New York to San Francisco- and then I had drummed up all this extra expense on myself even though we went there several times -- I never stayed there long enough to get rich and it was not a steady job. As long as we did this - we stayed but he liked to change bands, you know.
Yeah - there weren't any other jobs on the Coast that you could get at that time--
